metadata.title: Network Resiliency

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability ensuring network services remain available, degradable, and recoverable under adverse conditions.

props.name: technology-platform
props.remarks: Network availability, redundancy, failover, and recovery platforms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Resilient network architecture with fault containment, graceful degradation, and coordinated recovery.

props.name: data-entity
props.remarks: Network health metrics, dependency mappings, fault indicators, and recovery telemetry.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Network resiliency is implemented in accordance with SP 800-184 principles for anticipating, withstanding, recovering from, and adapting to adverse conditions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Resiliency is a required property of Zero Trust architectures and must be preserved under partial failure.

metadata.remarks: Network Resiliency defines how network services are designed, operated, and recovered to limit blast radius, preserve essential connectivity, and enable timely restoration following faults, attacks, or overload conditions. This pattern does not define access control or policy enforcement; it governs survivability, degradation behavior, and recovery coordination.

components.title: Fault Containment
components.description: Isolation of failures and disruptions to prevent cascading network impact.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Denial-of-service attacks causing resource exhaustion and cascading failure.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation of network resources to contain faults and prevent widespread impact.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Implement fault-tolerant and isolation mechanisms to contain network failures.

components.title: Graceful Degradation
components.description: Controlled reduction of network functionality to preserve critical services under stress.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Network denial-of-service causing abrupt loss of availability.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Prioritization and throttling preserve essential network services during overload.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Provide the capability to operate in a degraded mode while maintaining critical functions.

components.title: Dependency Isolation
components.description: Separation of network control-plane and data-plane dependencies to reduce systemic risk.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Service disruption through manipulation of shared dependencies.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Isolation of critical dependencies prevents cascading service failures.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Implement redundancy and isolation for critical network components.

components.title: Recovery Coordination
components.description: Coordinated restoration of network services following disruption.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Extended denial-of-service through delayed or disorganized recovery.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Planned and coordinated recovery procedures reduce restoration time.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Coordinate network recovery actions as part of contingency planning.
